text_blocks.snippet: NSAIDs, or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, are associated with an increased risk of cardiovascular events, including heart attack, stroke, and heart failure. This risk is heightened in individuals with pre-existing cardiovascular disease or those taking NSAIDs for extended periods. While naproxen may have a lower risk profile compared to other NSAIDs, the safest approach is to avoid NSAIDs altogether in patients with heart conditions, if possible.
